Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Scott
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 252 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, the district attorneys, the Board of Pardons and Paroles and the Department of Corrections by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by the bill and the penalties imposed.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Oliver
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 118 as introduced would exempt volunteer rescue squads from the payment of license and registration fees and ad valorem taxes for utility trailers beginning January 1, 2022. This bill would reduce receipts, cumulatively, to the Public School Fund, the State General Fund, the Alabama Veterans Assistance Fund, the Public Road and Bridge Fund and county and municipal funds by an estimated $1,400 annually, based on information provided by the Alabama Association of Rescue Squads.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
